title: ProMORNA: An End-to-End Generative Framework for Full-Length mRNA Design
abstract: arXiv:2605.01513v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Designing therapeutic messenger RNA (mRNA) requires generating full-length transcripts that optimally balance intracellular stability and translation efficiency. While generative models have advanced mRNA design, existing approaches rely on region-wise generation, expensive inference-time search, or target-specific model updates. To overcome these limitations, we introduce ProMORNA, a zero-shot, end-to-end generative framework for full-length mRNA design. ProMORNA aligns the design process with modern Large Language Model training pipelines: it utilizes a BART-style architecture pre-trained on over 6 million natural protein-mRNA pairs, followed by a two-stage post-training process comprising cold-start supervised fine-tuning and multi-objective reinforcement learning. By standardizing and aggregating relative advantages at the individual metric level with domain-specific stabilization, our post-training stage directly aligns the gene

translated_title: ProMORNA：一个用于全长mRNA设计的端到端生成框架
translated_abstract: 设计治疗性信使核糖核酸（mRNA）需要生成能够最佳平衡细胞内稳定性和翻译效率的全长转录本。虽然生成模型已经推动了mRNA设计的发展，但现有方法依赖于区域化生成、昂贵的推理时搜索或针对特定目标的模型更新。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了ProMORNA，一个用于全长mRNA设计的零样本端到端生成框架。ProMORNA将设计过程与现代大型语言模型训练流程相对齐：它利用在超过600万个天然蛋白质-mRNA对上预训练的BART风格架构，随后进行包含冷启动监督微调和多目标强化学习的两阶段后训练过程。通过在单个指标层面标准化和聚合相对优势，并结合领域特定的稳定化技术，我们的后训练阶段直接对齐基因（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: ProMORNA是一个零样本端到端生成框架，通过BART风格架构预训练及两阶段后训练（冷启动监督微调加多目标强化学习），直接生成全长治疗性mRNA，无需区域化生成或昂贵的推理时搜索。
en_tdlr: ProMORNA is a zero-shot, end-to-end generative framework for full-length mRNA design that leverages BART-style pre-training on 6 million protein-mRNA pairs and two-stage post-training (cold-start supervised fine-tuning and multi-objective reinforcement learning) to balance intracellular stability and translation efficiency without region-wise generation or expensive inference-time search.
